targets.query: SELECT uniqExact(session_id) AS started_sessions FROM apm_event_raw FINAL WHERE app_id = '$app_id' AND event_type = 'app_start' AND event_time BETWEEN toDateTime($from) AND toDateTime($to) AND (has([$app_version], 'All') OR app_version IN ($app_version)) AND (has([$channel], 'All') OR channel IN ($channel)) AND (has([$environment], 'All') OR environment IN ($environment)) AND (has([$os_version], 'All') OR os_version IN ($os_version)) AND (has([$device_model], 'All') OR device_model IN ($device_model))

SELECT if(started_sessions = 0, NULL, crashed_sessions / started_sessions * 1000) AS crash_rate_per_1000_sessions FROM (SELECT uniqExactIf(session_id, event_type = 'app_start') AS started_sessions, uniqExactIf(session_id, event_type = 'crash') AS crashed_sessions FROM apm_event_raw FINAL WHERE app_id = '$app_id' AND event_time BETWEEN toDateTime($from) AND toDateTime($to) AND (has([$app_version], 'All') OR app_version IN ($app_version)) AND (has([$channel], 'All') OR channel IN ($channel)) AND (has([$environment], 'All') OR environment IN ($environment)) AND (has([$os_version], 'All') OR os_version IN ($os_version)) AND (has([$device_model], 'All') OR device_model IN ($device_model)))

SELECT uniqExactIf(anonymous_device_id, event_type = 'crash') AS affected_devices FROM apm_event_raw FINAL WHERE app_id = '$app_id' AND event_time BETWEEN toDateTime($from) AND toDateTime($to) AND (has([$app_version], 'All') OR app_version IN ($app_version)) AND (has([$channel], 'All') OR channel IN ($channel)) AND (has([$environment], 'All') OR environment IN ($environment)) AND (has([$os_version], 'All') OR os_version IN ($os_version)) AND (has([$device_model], 'All') OR device_model IN ($device_model))

SELECT if(started_sessions = 0, NULL, 1 - crashed_sessions / started_sessions) AS crash_free_session_rate FROM (SELECT uniqExactIf(session_id, event_type = 'app_start') AS started_sessions, uniqExactIf(session_id, event_type = 'crash') AS crashed_sessions FROM apm_event_raw FINAL WHERE app_id = '$app_id' AND event_time BETWEEN toDateTime($from) AND toDateTime($to) AND (has([$app_version], 'All') OR app_version IN ($app_version)) AND (has([$channel], 'All') OR channel IN ($channel)) AND (has([$environment], 'All') OR environment IN ($environment)) AND (has([$os_version], 'All') OR os_version IN ($os_version)) AND (has([$device_model], 'All') OR device_model IN ($device_model)))

SELECT toStartOfHour(event_time) AS time, uniqExactIf(session_id, event_type = 'app_start') AS started_sessions, uniqExactIf(session_id, event_type = 'crash') AS crashed_sessions, if(started_sessions = 0, NULL, crashed_sessions / started_sessions * 1000) AS crash_rate_per_1000_sessions FROM apm_event_raw FINAL WHERE app_id = '$app_id' AND event_time BETWEEN toDateTime($from) AND toDateTime($to) AND (has([$app_version], 'All') OR app_version IN ($app_version)) AND (has([$channel], 'All') OR channel IN ($channel)) AND (has([$environment], 'All') OR environment IN ($environment)) AND (has([$os_version], 'All') OR os_version IN ($os_version)) AND (has([$device_model], 'All') OR device_model IN ($device_model)) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT crash_fingerprint AS fingerprint, any(crash_exception_type) AS exception_type, uniqExact(event_id) AS event_count, uniqExact(session_id) AS crashed_sessions, uniqExact(anonymous_device_id) AS affected_devices, min(event_time) AS first_seen_at, max(event_time) AS last_seen_at FROM apm_event_raw FINAL WHERE app_id = '$app_id' AND event_type = 'crash' AND event_time BETWEEN toDateTime($from) AND toDateTime($to) AND (has([$app_version], 'All') OR app_version IN ($app_version)) AND (has([$channel], 'All') OR channel IN ($channel)) AND (has([$environment], 'All') OR environment IN ($environment)) AND (has([$os_version], 'All') OR os_version IN ($os_version)) AND (has([$device_model], 'All') OR device_model IN ($device_model)) AND (has([$fingerprint], 'All') OR crash_fingerprint IN ($fingerprint)) GROUP BY crash_fingerprint ORDER BY event_count DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT app_version, uniqExactIf(session_id, event_type = 'app_start') AS started_sessions, uniqExactIf(session_id, event_type = 'crash') AS crashed_sessions, uniqExactIf(anonymous_device_id, event_type = 'crash') AS affected_devices, if(started_sessions = 0, NULL, crashed_sessions / started_sessions * 1000) AS crash_rate_per_1000_sessions FROM apm_event_raw FINAL WHERE app_id = '$app_id' AND event_time BETWEEN toDateTime($from) AND toDateTime($to) AND (has([$app_version], 'All') OR app_version IN ($app_version)) AND (has([$channel], 'All') OR channel IN ($channel)) AND (has([$environment], 'All') OR environment IN ($environment)) AND (has([$os_version], 'All') OR os_version IN ($os_version)) AND (has([$device_model], 'All') OR device_model IN ($device_model)) GROUP BY app_version ORDER BY app_version

options.content: 当启动会话数为 0 时，崩溃率显示为空并标记为分母不足；没有 Crash 行时显示为 0 仅在存在有效启动分母的情况下成立。问题排行链接进入后端事件列表，单事件详情接口会显示原始异常链、堆栈和 symbolicationStatus。
